quests.completion_criteria: Understand how to use for and while loops, and correctly write a loop that prints numbers from 1 to 10.

quests.title: Practice Loop Logic
quests.action: Write a loop that calculates the sum of numbers from 1 to 10 and verify the result.
quests.completion_criteria: The loop should correctly compute the sum and display it on the screen.
quests.hint: Use a for loop to iterate through numbers 1 to 10 and accumulate the sum.

quests.title: Apply Loop in Real Context
quests.action: Create a simple program that prints 'Hello, World!' 5 times using a loop.
quests.completion_criteria: The program should run and print 'Hello, World!' five times as expected.
quests.hint: Use a for loop with a range that iterates 5 times and print the message each iteration.
